page.layout: One printed page, page number 53 at top right. Running head "NOTÆ." at top centre. Main text in one block of roman and italic type, with an Arabic (Persian/Arabic script) passage set in a block below the Latin text. No margin notes. No catchword or signature visible.

main_text.p: nam praestes, & mense Ramadani jejunes, & ut adCaabam, si commode possis, peregrinationem religionis ergo instituas. Hanc definitionem testimonio suo comprobasse Gabrielem. Hinc ergo sectam suam AlEslam, Islamismum, se Muslemos, seu Islamitas appellant. at Judei transpositis literis, eos Ismaelitas, & religionem ipsorum Ismaelismum: per contemptum quidem, at nomine quod ipsi facile admiserint; utpote qui Ismaelem tam generis quam religionis suae parentem post Abrahamum agnoscant, nec aliam esse contendant quam profitentur doctrinam ab ea, quam ipse olim a patre Abrahamo acceptam professus, posteris suis commendatam reliquit. Quod si semel a Sharestanio didicerimus, melius quae postea dicenda sunt, & quid praetexuerit Mohammedes & quid egerit intelligemus. Sic igitur ille

[Arabic passage, set in right-to-left Arabic script, in the printed block below the Latin text:] لما ادشعب النور الوارد من ادم الي ابرهيم ثم الصادر عنه في شعبين شعب في بني اسرائيل وشعب في بني اسمعيل وكان النور المتحدر الي بني اسرائيل ظاهرا والنور المتحدر الي بني اسمعيل مخفيا كان يستتر على النور الظاهر بظهور الاشخاص واظهار الغيبوة في شخص شخص ويستدل على النور المخفي بابانة المناسك والمعلامات وستر الحال في الاشخاص وقبلة الفرقة الاولي يسيى المقدس وقبلة الفرقة الثانية بيت الله الحرام وشريعة الاولي ظواهر الاحكام وشريعة الثانية رعاية المشاعر الحرام وخصصا القريب
main_text.notes: The Arabic block is printed in Arabic script and transcribed as printed; several words in the scan are blurred and may contain errors, notably "ادشعب", "المعلامات", "الغيبوة" and "المتحدر", which are marked by their uncertain shape but not individually flagged here due to the scan's resolution. The Latin text carries "AlEslam" and "Muslemos" as printed; these are probably printing variants of "Alislam" and "Muslemos" and are left as seen. The first Latin paragraph is continued from the previous page.
